name: claude-bouncer
description: Guard rails for Claude Code: workspace boundaries, protected branches, production targets, lost exit status, and foreground time.

plugins.name: workspace-guard
plugins.description: Prompt before grep/sed/jq/awk/cat/head/tail touch files outside the workspace; deny blind process kills.

plugins.name: branch-guard
plugins.description: Cut routine git/gh approval prompts: auto-approve safe commands (read-only, staging, branch/worktree create, feature-branch commits & pushes) and confirm protected-branch or destructive ones.

plugins.name: prod-guard
plugins.description: Block mutating kubectl/helm/terraform/gcloud/aws/az/docker commands aimed at production; prompt when they rely on clobber-prone ambient context.

plugins.name: exit-status-guard
plugins.description: Deny a gate piped into a filter, backgrounded behind an echo, or sequenced before a state change with `;` — every shape where a failure reads as success.

plugins.name: foreground-guard
plugins.description: Prompt before foreground polling/watching (gh run watch, tail -f, sleep-loops) and before known-slow commands run with an inadequate timeout.
